evals.prompt: I'm building a product called SecretStack — a secure, embeddable credential vault API for SaaS companies whose AI agents need to authenticate to third-party services on behalf of end users. I want to build a competitive market intelligence knowledge base from scratch. Please: (1) create the proper vault folder structure, (2) define 2 ICP notes, (3) research and create complete notes for these 5 companies: 1Password, Bitwarden, Doppler, HashiCorp Vault, and Infisical. Make the notes scored and specific to why SecretStack would matter to each of them.
evals.expected_output: A vault structure with Market Landscape/Prospects and Competitors folders, 2 ICP notes with proper frontmatter, 5 company notes each with complete frontmatter (type, tier/fit, priority, funding, founders), a why-SecretStack section, and a _Index.md master index.

evals.prompt: I'm building a credential management product for AI agents. Do a deep dive into the AI browser automation agent space — find 5-6 companies whose agents log into websites or services on behalf of users and would desperately need a credential management layer. For each company, produce a complete market intelligence note with scoring. Also write a brief synthesis of the key signals in this vertical.
evals.expected_output: 5-6 complete company notes with consistent frontmatter (abadge_fit or fit score, priority, funding, founders), specific 'why this product matters' sections for each, and a synthesis note capturing themes and top recommendations.

evals.prompt: I'm building an authentication API for AI agents. Add Retool to my competitive landscape as a thorough market intelligence note. Retool recently launched 'Retool Agents' — AI agents that connect to company databases and APIs. Research them thoroughly: their agent capabilities, funding (they've raised a lot), founders, customer base, and specifically why a credential management product would matter to Retool Agents. Make the note complete, scored, and useful for outreach.
evals.expected_output: A complete Retool.md note with: full frontmatter (type, tier or fit score, priority, all funding details, founder names with social handles), a specific 'why credential management matters' section tied to Retool Agents specifically, recent strategic signals, and research_status: complete.
